Vacancies: 14 · Posts: 3 designation(s) · Type: State University · Accompanist (Sangatkarta) posts (status not stated) · Mode: Online registration + Demand Draft · Fee: ₹500 (General/OBC/EWS/PwBD) / ₹300 (SC) · Apply: 24 October–23 November 2026 · Salary: Level-4 (₹25,500–81,100) · Selection: Interview + Performance Demonstration · Location: Lucknow, UP
Bhatkhande Sanskriti Vishwavidyalaya, Lucknow invites applications for 14 Accompanist (Sangatkarta) posts in Tabla, Sarangi and Gayan (Loknritya) on Pay Level-4. The advertisement number is 1568/भा.सं.विवि.-1(1)/2025टी.सी., dated 22 October 2026. Selection rests on an interview that includes a performance demonstration.
The university is a state university in Uttar Pradesh focused on Indian classical music, dance and related arts. The posts are based in Lucknow. Candidates must hold a Degree, Visharad or equivalent qualification in the related subject.
Applications open on the Samarth portal from the publication date of 24 October 2026. The last date to submit or upload the application is 23 November 2026. A Demand Draft for the fee must also be enclosed.
⚠️ Application Alerts: check these before you submit the form.
Only one application is valid per post; a second application for the same post is not accepted.
A Demand Draft is required even though the form is uploaded on the portal; missing DD leads to non-acceptance.
Candidates working in an educational institution must attach a No Objection Certificate; without it the application is incomplete.
Applications received after 23 November 2026 will not be accepted.

The SahisarkariJobs.in Analyst's Take – Is This Recruitment for You?
This is a state university recruitment for music accompanists on a printed Level-4 pay scale. The process is interview-based with a compulsory performance demonstration, so practical skill in the chosen instrument or style matters as much as the degree or Visharad. The three-year experience and AIR-graded artist status are only preference factors.
Best fit: Candidates who already perform regularly on Tabla, Sarangi or in folk vocal/dance accompaniment and hold the required academic qualification with the minimum marks.
Who should skip: Those without a Degree, Visharad or equivalent in the specific subject, or those unable to demonstrate performance at the interview.
Practical tip: Prepare the Demand Draft in the exact favour name printed in the notice and keep the portal submission and DD together; the notice treats both as part of a valid application.
